overview_description.description: Revyl is an observability platform that helps teams identify and resolve bugs before they reach production. It offers real-time monitoring and insights, allowing developers to catch issues early in the development process. With features such as error detection and performance analytics, Revyl enhances software reliability and improves the overall user experience.

about_short_description.short_description: Revyl is an observability platform designed to proactively catch and fix bugs before they reach production.

product.name: Agentic Flows
product.description: Agentic Flows are end-to-end tests designed to replicate real user interactions and resist UI changes, running throughout the development lifecycle from local to production.

product.name: Telemetry Data Integration
product.description: Telemetry Data Integration connects testing with existing telemetry infrastructure to facilitate root cause analysis of bugs by linking frontend interactions to backend traces.

product.name: Automated Bug Triaging
product.description: Automated Bug Triaging provides observability across the entire software stack to identify and prioritize bugs quickly, enabling faster resolution.

product.name: Cross-Platform End-to-End Testing
product.description: Cross-Platform End-to-End Testing offers consistent and robust testing for iOS, Android, and web applications, reducing flaky and unreliable test results.
